questions.question: Near the end, after the Snake class code, a group of library logos pops onto a dark screen one after another. Which logo is on screen first?
questions.answer: NumPy (it appears alone first, then pandas, then Keras and Django, then TensorFlow)

questions.question: In the dark terminal with a '>>>' Python prompt, what command is typed in just before the Zen of Python text appears?
While the Zen of Python lines are on screen, a yellow dot marks lines one at a time. Which way does it move through the lines, and which line is the third one it marks?
questions.answer: It moves down, line by line: 'Beautiful is better than ugly', then 'Explicit is better than implicit', then third 'Simple is better than complex'.
accept: down; Simple is better than complex
downward, Simple is better than complex

questions.question: How many separate times does a pointing-finger hand emoji appear over the code editor during the video?
questions.answer: 4 times (next to VARIABLE, beside the line ending in a semicolon, next to 4 SPACES PER BLOCK, and next to ANONYMOUS FUNCTIONS)

questions.question: A man wearing a green apron with a Python logo appears beside the code. For about how long is he on screen?
What animal is on screen when the speaker says 'We're currently at version 3 of the language', and what is shown over it?
questions.answer: A close-up of a yellow-orange snake (a python), with a large white number 3 over it
